title: Hormuz Convoy: the undeclared Iran war
oneLine: Since strikes killed Ali Khamenei in February 2026, a US blockade of Iran and Revolutionary Guards attacks on shipping have kept the world's key oil strait half shut.

whoIsWho.stance: Wants the strait open and no Iranian bomb, without a ground war; just lost Congress.
Iran's new Supreme Leader, reportedly wounded and rarely seen; the Guards fill the gap.
Attacks tankers near Hormuz and argues for answering every US move with fire.
His ports and skyline are in range; he hedges between Washington and Tehran.
Co-belligerent since February; says Israel will strike alone if needed.

whyItMatters: About a fifth of the world's oil normally passes through Hormuz, so every attack moves prices everywhere. And more than 200 kg of near-bomb-grade uranium is believed hidden in Isfahan, unseen by inspectors since February.

timeline.text: Israel and the US bomb Iran's nuclear sites in a 12-day war.
US-Israeli strikes kill Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei; war begins.
The Assembly of Experts names his son Mojtaba Supreme Leader.
The US Navy begins blockading Iranian ports.
A framework agreed in Islamabad collapses; the blockade returns.
Revolutionary Guards attacks hit more than 24 ships near Hormuz.
Tehran calls a letter from Vice President Vance 'a positive step'.
